'''Shalimin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], Shalimin was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and sent to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After years of group study within the walls of the Temple, Shalimin was noticed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Upulu]] who quickly took him as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].

As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], broke out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] Shalimin was given the title of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] and fought on many fronts. Serving alongside [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Dac]], Shalimin shamed his master when he reveled deeply in the victory. In order to reprimand his student, Upulu sent Shalimin to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]] to serve under [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the [[Battle of Argul|battle]] there. Greatly disliking the world, Shalimin nonetheless fought alongside other master-less Padawans against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], forcing an uneasy stand-off until reinforcements arrived, which led to a Republic victory.<ref name="Only the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shalimin made his only appearance in ''[[Only the Force]]'', a scenario for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. In that, the player playing as Shalimun can choose Shalimun's sex. However, he is described as male in the biographies of the other playable characters, so that can be assumed to be his canonical sex.
